column2: Holder is an explicit ProcessGlobals object (Java has no globalThis); idiomatic Java would use a static holder / enum singleton, which cannot be reset per test case.
Module-level objects are already singletons via the import cache; the holder mirrors globalThis with a plain object; 'or' expresses ??.
Closest to the source: ?? for reuse-or-create and an object standing in for globalThis; module cache gives the singleton in real code.
Holder owns the client through std::shared_ptr so identity (pointer equality) survives reloads; a function-local static (Meyers singleton) is the usual C++ form.
